name: Overcast
description: A halftone of cloud: discs swelling and shrinking with a smooth field, crowding into pale banks and thinning to specks where the sky clears.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --n: @rn(-0.2, 1.2, 1.5); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -30%; background: @match($(n) > 0.62, @p(var(--color1)), $(n) > 0.32, @p(var(--color2)), @p(var(--color3))); -webkit-clip-path: circle(@calc(3 + 29 * max(0, min(1, $(n))))% at 50% 50%); clip-path: circle(@calc(3 + 29 * max(0, min(1, $(n))))% at 50% 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
